comment: Authored areas of the precious-gems group (decision 0065). Witwatersrand goldfields: simplified mined/subcrop outlines of each goldfield (about 2-5 km precision), reef beds at the median mined depth (the real reefs dip; a flat bed cannot follow them). Endowment per field = production to about 2010 plus remaining resources, apportioned from the basin total of about 81,000 t Au (see docs/research/ore-deposits-2026-11-08/precious-gems.md). bed.cover is derived by build_catalogue.py from mt / (area x thickM x density) and is not authored. Grades are historic average head grades of each field.

areas.name: Witwatersrand: Central Rand goldfield (Johannesburg)
areas.note: Main Reef, Main Reef Leader and South Reef; the 1886 discovery outcrop along the ridge

areas.name: Witwatersrand: East Rand goldfield (Benoni-Springs-Nigel)
areas.note: Main Reef Leader in the East Rand basin

areas.name: Witwatersrand: Far West Rand (West Wits Line, Carletonville)
areas.note: Ventersdorp Contact Reef and Carbon Leader (Driefontein, Kloof, Mponeng, South Deep); mined to 4 km

areas.name: Witwatersrand: Klerksdorp goldfield (Vaal Reefs, KOSH)
areas.note: Ventersdorp Contact Reef and Vaal Reef

areas.name: Witwatersrand: Free State goldfield (Welkom-Odendaalsrus-Virginia)
areas.note: B Reef / Beatrix reef and Basal Reef under Karoo cover; discovered 1946

areas.name: Witwatersrand: Evander goldfield (Kinross-Winkelhaak)
areas.note: Kimberley Reef in the Evander basin
